documents.title: CBL and Its Experiential Learning Foundations
documents.short-description: Challenge Based Learning explicitly situates itself within a long tradition of progressive and experiential education.

documents.title: CBL Foundational Ideas and Design Principles
documents.short-description: The CBL framework "builds on a set of foundational ideas" — persistent orientations that inform the entire approach, not steps in a process (CBL Guide 2016, p. 8).

documents.title: CBL Implementation Scales and Entry Points
documents.short-description: Guide-backed implementation scales from bounded Challenge events to an overarching institutional approach, including multiple entry points and Challenge variations.

documents.title: The PIONEER-Alliance Definition of Challenge-Based Education
documents.short-description: The PIONEER-Alliance CBE definition: how CBE differs from PBL/PjBL, the seven operationalised PIONEER criteria with maturity cues, the multi-actor ecosystem, and the SDG11 impact orientation.

documents.title: The Challenge Based Learning Three-Phase Framework
documents.short-description: Challenge Based Learning (CBL) organizes the learning experience into three interconnected phases: Engage, Investigate, and Act.

documents.title: Process Assessment Patterns: Artefacts and Rubrics for Process-Oriented CBE
documents.short-description: When a CBE goal is process-oriented, assessment needs process artefacts and process-sensitive rubrics; otherwise the rubric rewards only the final product and the process goal goes unmeasured.

documents.short-description: The PIONEER CBE maturity continuum: three levels (CBE light, good practice, full-fledged) across the seven PIONEER criteria as a 3×7 raster, with synonym mapping and minimum/excellence vocabulary.

documents.title: The PIONEER Ten-Step CBE Module Design Flow
documents.short-description: The PIONEER ten-step CBE module design flow (§4.6): ten steps with named outputs, backward-design (evidence first), the coherence gate after step 3, and iterative three-round use.

documents.short-description: Glossary of CBL core terms (Big Idea, Essential Question, Challenge Statement, Guiding Questions) plus the PBL/CBL distinction and the meta-skills terminology gap.
